_about: CostVision brand tokens — the one source for the app's light theme and PDF export, the deck generators (build_*.py / build_*.mjs) and the rate-card workbook. Values are hex without '#'. Every 'onLight' colour passes WCAG AA (4.5:1) as text on white and on 'page'. The dark theme uses the brighter 'onDark' variants of the same hues: a text colour tuned for white turns to mush on navy, and the reverse. Edit here, then run: node scripts/brand-css.mjs (regenerates src/ui/styles/brand.css) and the deck generators.
